adrs.title: Multi-repo over monorepo
adrs.decision: Organize the system into multiple repositories under the mastrocola-dev organization, one per concern, to independently demonstrate microservice decomposition and enable per-component versioning and access control.

adrs.title: Public site on Azure Static Web Apps with DNS as code
adrs.decision: Host the public site on Azure Static Web Apps Free plan with DNS records declared in Terraform using the Cloudflare provider, providing zero-cost global CDN with managed TLS and independent site deployment.

adrs.title: Agent language, LLM integration, and RAG decoupling
adrs.decision: Build the agent in TypeScript using the official MCP SDK with direct Anthropic API access, while deferring RAG implementation to Python via separate MCP servers to decouple the host language from tools.

adrs.title: TypeScript without a build step and MCP server distribution
adrs.decision: Run TypeScript directly on Node 24 without compilation and distribute MCP servers as independent Container Apps rather than packages, keeping all repositories independently deployable.

adrs.title: Agent-generated content lives at its source and is read at runtime
adrs.decision: Run the agent in the docs repository on pull requests, commit output indexed by source tree hash, and have the site fetch generated content at runtime with runtime validation.

adrs.title: One workload identity per repository and Key Vault as the only secret store
adrs.decision: Eliminate GitHub secrets by assigning each repository a separate user-managed identity federated with GitHub OIDC and storing all credentials in a single Key Vault with role-based access control.
